anchorAudit.rationale: The finished photograph shows a separate overbed-table column, bed casters and a hanging blue blanket. The monitor has a black screen, a silver rim, a wall arm and a wire basket. The pole carries one pump and a clear bag. The cabinet top holds one handled pitcher and one blue-and-white cup. A tissue box, a separate diagnostic unit, concealed mechanisms and the gas identities of the wall fittings cannot be identified in this image and remain index terms.
